title: The algebraic exterior of conormal sections identifies with the affine model sections
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-closed-immersion], let $U$ be an affine open of $Y$, let $V=i^{-1}U$, and $n\geq0$. Put $N=i^*(\ker i)$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], [def-pc-module-pullback], $A=\Gamma(Y,U)$, $I=(\ker i)(U)$, $B=\Gamma(Z,V)$, and $M=\bigwedge^n_{A/I}(I/I^2)$ regarded as an $A$-module [new-r4-self-tor-conormal-comparison]. Let $T$ be the associated-module, chart-restriction, open-pushforward, and tensor-pullback functor of [new-t2-self-tor-affine-section]. There exists a $B$-linear equivalence $\bigwedge^n_B N(V)\simeq T(M)(V)$ which sends the wedge of the canonical pullback-unit images of every tuple $b_j\in(\ker i)(U)$ to $\mathrm{selfTorAffineSection}(i,U,M,\mathrm{selfTorIdealWedge}(i,U,n,b))$ [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction], [new-t2-self-tor-affine-section]. The source is an algebraic exterior module, not sections of the exterior sheaf.

theorem exists_selfTor_conormal_exterior_section_model
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    (n : ℕ) (U : Y.affineOpens) :
    let N := (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules
    let M := conormalExteriorModule (Γ(Y, U.1) : Type u) (i.ker.ideal U) n
    let T := tilde.functor Γ(Y, U.1) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor U.2.isoSpec.hom ⋙
      Scheme.Modules.pushforward U.1.ι ⋙ Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i
    ∃ e : (⋀[Z.presheaf.obj (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))]^n
        (N.val.obj (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)))) ≃ₗ[Z.presheaf.obj (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))]
        (T.obj M).val.obj (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1)),
      ∀ b : Fin n → i.ker.toModules.val.obj (op U.1),
        e (exteriorPower.ιMulti (Z.presheaf.obj (op (i ⁻¹ᵁ U.1))) n
          (fun j ↦ ((Classical.choose
            (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction i)).unit.app
              i.ker.toModules).val.app (op U.1) (b j))) =
          selfTorAffineSection i U M (selfTorIdealWedge i U n b)
